slides.say: Your subscribe function gets called after every re-render. Look where it is declared.
Declared inside the component, it is a different function every render. React resubscribes whenever subscribe changes.
Move it outside the component. Now it is always the same function.

slides.text: Needs a prop like userId? Wrap it in useCallback with [userId].
slides.say: If it needs a prop, like user id, wrap it in use callback, so it only changes when user id changes.
